run_torchbeast_server: run a torchbeast Server on localhost:12345 that serves bound functions and modules
bind_torchscript_module: bind a torch.jit.script module to the torchbeast Server under a named endpoint
bind_python_function: bind a plain Python function to the torchbeast Server for remote invocation
bind_batched_function: bind a function to the torchbeast Server with a specified batch_size for batched execution
stop_and_wait_server: stop the running torchbeast Server and wait for it to fully shut down
